$comment: A preview edit (CONTRACT.md 11, references/edit.md): the frames of recorded takes on a timeline, how the parts join, the camera, and the overlays, for compose.py. Times are seconds or "@mark" / "@mark+s" / "@mark-s" (a mark a segment sets). Footage positions (touch points, a spotlight's rect) are the footage's own pixels, as dumped. Uses only the subset appstores_lib/schema.py validates.

name.$comment: Names the output: <out>/<name>/ for the frames, <out>/<name>-master.mp4.

fps.$comment: The output rate. Apple takes at most 30 fps; the default is 30.

framePattern.$comment: The frame files' names in a take's folder (printf style). Default frame-%05d.jpg (video.py frames).

style.$comment: A store-screenshots screenshot-style.json: its palette, first font and image background become the preview's, so the video and the screenshots match.

styleRoot.$comment: Where the style's relative paths (fonts, the background image) are, when not beside it: usually the screenshots config's folder.

background.$comment: An image for the background, over the theme's (a path, relative to the edit).

headSize.$comment: The largest headline size (px). Every headline gets one size: the largest at which each line fits on one line.

headTop.$comment: Headlines' top (stage px) unless one sets its own.

slideShift.$comment: How far a slide moves the screens (stage px). Default 720.

footages.$comment: More footages by name (a segment's "footage"), e.g. a foldable's open display alongside its cover display ("main").

camera.$comment: [time, k] keys: k 0 the screen floating on the background at its float scale, 1 pushed in to its full scale. Eased between keys; held outside them.

pan.$comment: [time, x] keys (stage px) moving a wide footage (one with "pan": true) sideways, a pane at a time.

endOut.$comment: When the screen sinks away for the end card.

time.$comment: Seconds from the start (negative: already under way at the first frame, so it opens composed), or a mark.

theme.$comment: The look without a style, or over it. Paths are relative to the edit.

footage.$comment: A take's frames: w x h pixels as dumped.

frame.$comment: The drawn device frame, store-screenshots' class (bezel and corner radius as fractions of the screen's short side). none: the screen alone, still rounded by nothing.

full.$comment: The scale pushed in (camera 1). Keep the whole device on the stage: about 0.8 for a phone at the stage's width.

float.$comment: The scale and centre (stage px) floating on the background (camera 0).

pan.$comment: A wide screen shown a pane at a time: stays floating, moved by the edit's pan keys; no spotlight on it.

oneOf.$comment: Frames from one take's folder (relative to the edit): held, played, marked.
A dissolve: the next segment fades in over the last seconds of the one before.
A slide: the outgoing screen holds and leaves left, the next arrives from the right.
A headline on the background: lines that rise in through their masks and leave faster. [Bracketed] words take the accent.
A touch hotspot on the main footage: appears at "at" (footage px), presses, optionally moves to "to" (a drag), leaves.
A spotlight: everything but one element dims. rect is the element's [x, y, w, h] and r its corner radius (footage px, measured from the frames); pad an even margin round it.

end.$comment: The end card on the background: the mark (an icon, relative to the edit), the name, who makes it, a tag line or two, and the fine print (account and subscription disclosure, references/apple-previews.md).
